slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: A creative technologist would start from the room, not the software: throw distance, projector lumens versus ambient light, where people stand, how many at once, and what happens when nobody is there (an attract mode).

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: 240 fps phone video of 20 trials: median motion-to-photon latency under 100 ms, recountable from the footage.
8-hour soak CSV: fps at or above 30 for 99% of samples, zero unrecovered crashes, cold boot after power pull without input.

slides.heading: Tracking collapses under projector light
paras: landmarks jump when the visitor is lit.
move the camera off-axis, use the heavy model, add IR light with an IR webcam.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 8 of 9. Biggest failure mode. Tracking collapses under projector light. Tell: landmarks jump when the visitor is lit. Fix: move the camera off-axis, use the heavy model, add IR light with an IR webcam.
